LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 PREPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Where do we keep different things in school? 2.Where do we keep different things at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self –efficacy: Knowing my school as the learner uses prepositions correctly in communication.

Values:
Respect: acceptance as the learner appreciates peers during playing of language games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill: Effective communication is enhanced as the learner retells (using signs) the story in their own words.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate sign reading comprehension to their learning in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources
